summary: Preparadas cinco guías de MemWhale #423: candidato versus confirmación, procedencia, desactivación y excepción Rho. Nueve controles estáticos aprobados, repetidos en copia limpia. Sin envío, aplicación ni verificación de clientes en vivo. Kernel no ejecutado.
criteria: Add identical recall-note wording in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini capture guides in a section shorter than ten lines, linking to release 0.20.0.
Explain possible versus confirmed fixes, the two-episode threshold, who last ran the candidate, shared local-store scope, and MEMORYWHALE_HOOK_FEEDBACK=0 without treating history as causal proof.
State explicitly that Rho capture does not emit recall notes; remove the obsolete fix-that-worked wording without changing hook setup or runtime capabilities.

Check the claims against pinned Rust source and release notes, preserve the eight required guide headings and existing command blocks, validate links and portable patch with reproducible credential-free checks; do not claim live client verification.
